paragraphs: Noble Software Group sells assessment and case planning software for probation and corrections agencies. The page states that the company is empowering Correctional Departments to maintain efficient budgets while decreasing recidivism rates. Delivery is offered either as a cloud-based subscription or as an on-premise solution.

Risk and needs assessments are one of the product areas named on the page, and the company works with the authors and researchers that create them. Custom assessment automation is offered for agencies that do not find the tool they want. Case planning is described as clear insight into the needs of supervised individuals.

The software is described as integrated with the buyer's system of record. Browser support is stated for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Microsoft Edge. Training options and step-by-step guides are offered, tailored to each individual in a department. Testimonials on the page come from Galveston County Probation, Texas and Parker County Juvenile Probation, Texas.
